# NEW 2026-11-19 v6.4 D3 colonisation framework (phase 1, resettlement). Generated by gen_colonization.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# BYZ scope; scope:oe_col_loc saved. oe_col_group = the group the target can take (1 Albanians, 2 Cumans, 3 Armenians, 4 Alans), the local one first; none: the variable is removed and option b of oe_col.1 does not show.
oe_col_pick_group = {
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_group } remove_variable = oe_col_group }
    if = {
        limit = { oe_col_g1_ok = yes scope:oe_col_loc ?= { oe_col_albanian_lands = yes } }
        set_variable = { name = oe_col_group value = 1 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { oe_col_g3_ok = yes scope:oe_col_loc ?= { oe_col_east_lands = yes } }
        set_variable = { name = oe_col_group value = 3 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { oe_col_g2_ok = yes }
        random_list = {
            50 = { set_variable = { name = oe_col_group value = 2 } }
            50 = { set_variable = { name = oe_col_group value = 4 } }
        }
    }
    else_if = { limit = { oe_col_g1_ok = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_col_group value = 1 } }
    else_if = { limit = { oe_col_g3_ok = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_col_group value = 3 } }
}

# BYZ scope; scope:oe_col_loc saved. New pops of group var:oe_col_group at the target: peasants 1.0 and soldiers 0.3 (thousands). Phase 2's events reuse it.
oe_col_add_settlers = {
    if = {
        limit = { exists = scope:oe_col_loc }
        if = {
            limit = { var:oe_col_group ?= 1 }
            scope:oe_col_loc = {
                add_pop = {
                    culture = culture:albanian
                    religion = religion:orthodox
                    type = pop_type:peasants
                    size = 1.0
                }
                add_pop = {
                    culture = culture:albanian
                    religion = religion:orthodox
                    type = pop_type:soldiers
                    size = 0.3
                }
            }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { var:oe_col_group ?= 2 }
            scope:oe_col_loc = {
                add_pop = {
                    culture = culture:cuman_culture
                    religion = religion:orthodox
                    type = pop_type:peasants
                    size = 1.0
                }
                add_pop = {
                    culture = culture:cuman_culture
                    religion = religion:orthodox
                    type = pop_type:soldiers
                    size = 0.3
                }
            }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { var:oe_col_group ?= 3 }
            scope:oe_col_loc = {
                add_pop = {
                    culture = culture:armenian_culture
                    religion = religion:miaphysite
                    type = pop_type:peasants
                    size = 1.0
                }
                add_pop = {
                    culture = culture:armenian_culture
                    religion = religion:miaphysite
                    type = pop_type:soldiers
                    size = 0.3
                }
            }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { var:oe_col_group ?= 4 }
            scope:oe_col_loc = {
                add_pop = {
                    culture = culture:alan_culture
                    religion = religion:orthodox
                    type = pop_type:peasants
                    size = 1.0
                }
                add_pop = {
                    culture = culture:alan_culture
                    religion = religion:orthodox
                    type = pop_type:soldiers
                    size = 0.3
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

# BYZ scope. Event counter oe_dbg_n_col (test page).
oe_col_count = {
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_dbg_n_col } } set_variable = { name = oe_dbg_n_col value = 0 } }
    change_variable = { name = oe_dbg_n_col add = 1 }
}

# BYZ scope, the first month. Starts the books.
oe_col_init = {
    set_variable = oe_col_on
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_col_n_settled } }
        set_variable = { name = oe_col_n_settled value = 0 }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_col_pop_added } }
        set_variable = { name = oe_col_pop_added value = 0 }
    }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_dbg_n_col } } set_variable = { name = oe_dbg_n_col value = 0 } }
}

# BYZ scope, monthly. Each migration slot counts down; at 0 the move is over: oe_col_n_settled +1 and, while the place is still ours, a quarrel is queued there (60 % after foreign settlers, 40 % after an internal move; due 12-24 months later).
oe_col_slot_tick = {
    if = {
        limit = { has_variable = oe_col_s1_loc }
        change_variable = { name = oe_col_s1_m add = -1 }
        if = {
            limit = { var:oe_col_s1_m <= 0 }
            var:oe_col_s1_loc ?= {
                if = {
                    limit = { owner ?= c:BYZ }
                    if = {
                        limit = { c:BYZ = { var:oe_col_s1_kind ?= 2 } }
                        random = {
                            chance = 60
                            set_variable = { name = oe_col_dsp value = 2 }
                            set_variable = { name = oe_col_dsp_due value = { integer_range = { min = 12 max = 24 } } }
                            change_variable = { name = oe_col_dsp_due add = oe_ml_month_now }
                            c:BYZ = { set_variable = oe_col_dsp_on }
                        }
                    }
                    else = {
                        random = {
                            chance = 40
                            set_variable = { name = oe_col_dsp value = 1 }
                            set_variable = { name = oe_col_dsp_due value = { integer_range = { min = 12 max = 24 } } }
                            change_variable = { name = oe_col_dsp_due add = oe_ml_month_now }
                            c:BYZ = { set_variable = oe_col_dsp_on }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            if = {
                limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_col_n_settled } }
                set_variable = { name = oe_col_n_settled value = 0 }
            }
            change_variable = { name = oe_col_n_settled add = 1 }
            remove_variable = oe_col_s1_loc
            remove_variable = oe_col_s1_m
            remove_variable = oe_col_s1_kind
        }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { has_variable = oe_col_s2_loc }
        change_variable = { name = oe_col_s2_m add = -1 }
        if = {
            limit = { var:oe_col_s2_m <= 0 }
            var:oe_col_s2_loc ?= {
                if = {
                    limit = { owner ?= c:BYZ }
                    if = {
                        limit = { c:BYZ = { var:oe_col_s2_kind ?= 2 } }
                        random = {
                            chance = 60
                            set_variable = { name = oe_col_dsp value = 2 }
                            set_variable = { name = oe_col_dsp_due value = { integer_range = { min = 12 max = 24 } } }
                            change_variable = { name = oe_col_dsp_due add = oe_ml_month_now }
                            c:BYZ = { set_variable = oe_col_dsp_on }
                        }
                    }
                    else = {
                        random = {
                            chance = 40
                            set_variable = { name = oe_col_dsp value = 1 }
                            set_variable = { name = oe_col_dsp_due value = { integer_range = { min = 12 max = 24 } } }
                            change_variable = { name = oe_col_dsp_due add = oe_ml_month_now }
                            c:BYZ = { set_variable = oe_col_dsp_on }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            if = {
                limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_col_n_settled } }
                set_variable = { name = oe_col_n_settled value = 0 }
            }
            change_variable = { name = oe_col_n_settled add = 1 }
            remove_variable = oe_col_s2_loc
            remove_variable = oe_col_s2_m
            remove_variable = oe_col_s2_kind
        }
    }
}

# BYZ scope. Drops stale quarrels (the settlers' modifiers are gone) and the flag when none is left.
oe_col_dsp_clean = {
    every_owned_location = {
        limit = {
            has_variable = oe_col_dsp
            NOT = { has_location_modifier = oe_col_homesteads }
            NOT = { has_location_modifier = oe_col_foreign_settlers }
        }
        remove_variable = oe_col_dsp
        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_dsp_due } remove_variable = oe_col_dsp_due }
    }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { any_owned_location = { has_variable = oe_col_dsp } } } remove_variable = oe_col_dsp_on }
}

# BYZ scope; scope:oe_col_dsp_pick saved. That place's quarrel becomes the one of oe_col.2 (oe_col_dsp_loc, oe_col_dsp_kind) and leaves the queue.
oe_col_dsp_take = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_col_dsp_loc value = scope:oe_col_dsp_pick }
    set_variable = { name = oe_col_dsp_kind value = scope:oe_col_dsp_pick.var:oe_col_dsp }
    scope:oe_col_dsp_pick = {
        remove_variable = oe_col_dsp
        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_dsp_due } remove_variable = oe_col_dsp_due }
    }
}

# Location scope. scope:oe_col_theme = the theme whose jurisdiction holds this place (none: unset).
oe_col_save_theme = {
    random_buildings_in_location = {
        limit = { oe_theme_building_trigger = yes owner ?= { oe_theme_member_trigger = yes } }
        owner = { save_scope_as = oe_col_theme }
    }
}

# BYZ scope; scope:oe_col_loc saved. scope:oe_col_src = Byzantium's most populous province that does not hold the target; scope:oe_col_amt = its monthly amount (oe_col_mig_amount).
oe_col_find_source = {
    scope:oe_col_loc ?= { province = { save_scope_as = oe_col_dst_prov } }
    if = {
        limit = { exists = scope:oe_col_dst_prov }
        ordered_province = {
            limit = { NOT = { this = scope:oe_col_dst_prov } }
            order_by = population
            save_scope_as = oe_col_src
        }
    }
    scope:oe_col_src ?= { save_scope_value_as = { name = oe_col_amt value = oe_col_mig_amount } }
}

# BYZ scope. scope:oe_col_loc = var:oe_col_target, with its theme, the source of an internal move and the group of foreign settlers; readouts oe_col_t_pop and oe_col_t_total for the texts.
oe_col_save_target = {
    var:oe_col_target ?= { save_scope_as = oe_col_loc }
    scope:oe_col_loc ?= { oe_col_save_theme = yes }
    if = {
        limit = { exists = scope:oe_col_loc }
        set_variable = { name = oe_col_t_pop value = scope:oe_col_loc.population }
    }
    oe_col_find_source = yes
    if = {
        limit = { exists = scope:oe_col_amt }
        set_variable = { name = oe_col_t_total value = { value = scope:oe_col_amt multiply = 24 } }
    }
    oe_col_pick_group = yes
}

# BYZ scope. oe_col.10: scope:oe_col_city = where the Nicomedian refugees live (the start event's modifier, Constantinople first); scope:oe_col_loc = their new home: the least populous sparse land in Thrace, else the first sparse land (oe_col_pick_score). Kept in oe_col_nic_city / oe_col_nic_to for the worker.
oe_col_save_nic = {
    if = {
        limit = { location:constantinople = { owner ?= c:BYZ has_location_modifier = oe_s37_nic_refugees } }
        location:constantinople = { save_scope_as = oe_col_city }
    }
    else = {
        random_owned_location = {
            limit = { has_location_modifier = oe_s37_nic_refugees }
            save_scope_as = oe_col_city
        }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { any_owned_location = { oe_col_sparse = yes oe_col_in_thrace = yes } }
        ordered_owned_location = {
            limit = { oe_col_sparse = yes oe_col_in_thrace = yes }
            order_by = oe_col_low_pop
            save_scope_as = oe_col_loc
        }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { oe_col_has_sparse = yes }
        ordered_owned_location = {
            limit = { oe_col_sparse = yes }
            order_by = oe_col_pick_score
            save_scope_as = oe_col_loc
        }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { exists = scope:oe_col_city }
        set_variable = { name = oe_col_nic_city value = scope:oe_col_city }
    }
    if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_col_loc } set_variable = { name = oe_col_nic_to value = scope:oe_col_loc } }
    else = { if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_nic_to } remove_variable = oe_col_nic_to } }
}

# BYZ scope. Sends oe_col.1 if its trigger holds (the choice of settlers (action, AI, test page); no quiet months after it): takes the main-line month (line 16) so no other main-line event follows this month.
oe_col_fire_1 = {
    if = {
        limit = { oe_col_ev_ok_1 = yes }
        oe_ml_take_as = { line = 16 }
        oe_col_count = yes
        trigger_event_non_silently = oe_col.1
    }
}

# BYZ scope. Sends oe_col.2 if its trigger holds (the quarrel; 6 quiet months after it): takes the main-line month (line 16) so no other main-line event follows this month.
oe_col_fire_2 = {
    if = {
        limit = { oe_col_ev_ok_2 = yes }
        set_variable = { name = oe_col_ev_cd months = 6 }
        oe_ml_take_as = { line = 16 }
        oe_col_count = yes
        trigger_event_non_silently = oe_col.2
    }
}

# BYZ scope. Sends oe_col.10 if its trigger holds (the Nicomedian refugees (once); 6 quiet months after it): takes the main-line month (line 16) so no other main-line event follows this month.
oe_col_fire_10 = {
    if = {
        limit = { oe_col_ev_ok_10 = yes }
        set_variable = { name = oe_col_ev_cd months = 6 }
        set_variable = { name = oe_col_fired_10 value = 1 }
        oe_ml_take_as = { line = 16 }
        oe_col_count = yes
        trigger_event_non_silently = oe_col.10
    }
}

# BYZ scope; scope:oe_col_pick saved (a sparse location). Starts a resettlement: costs 2 Imperial Authority, the action cools down 24 months, oe_col.1 opens for that place.
oe_col_start = {
    international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars = {
        change_variable = { name = oe_pillars_authority add = -2 }
        clamp_variable = { name = oe_pillars_authority min = 0 max = 100 }
    }
    set_variable = { name = oe_col_target value = scope:oe_col_pick }
    set_variable = { name = oe_col_act_cd months = 24 }
    oe_col_fire_1 = yes
}

# BYZ scope, monthly. oe_col.10 while the start event's refugees modifier lasts (20 % a month when the line is free); once it is gone unfired, oe_col_fired_10 = 2 (dropped).
oe_col_try_10 = {
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_col_fired_10 } current_date >= 1338.1.1 }
        if = {
            limit = { oe_col_ev_ok_10 = yes }
            if = { limit = { oe_col_ev_free = yes } random = { chance = 20 oe_col_fire_10 = yes } }
        }
        else = { set_variable = { name = oe_col_fired_10 value = 2 } }
    }
}

# BYZ scope, monthly. The first due quarrel becomes oe_col.2 when the line is free.
oe_col_try_2 = {
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_dsp_on } oe_col_dsp_clean = yes }
    if = {
        limit = { has_variable = oe_col_dsp_on oe_col_ev_free = yes any_owned_location = { oe_col_dsp_ready = yes } }
        random_owned_location = { limit = { oe_col_dsp_ready = yes } save_scope_as = oe_col_dsp_pick }
        oe_col_dsp_take = yes
        oe_col_fire_2 = yes
    }
}

# BYZ scope, January. The AI's roll (20 %): the first sparse place (reclaimed land first, then the least populous) gets oe_col.1, as if the action had been used.
oe_col_ai_year = {
    if = {
        limit = { oe_col_ai_ok = yes }
        random = {
            chance = 20
            ordered_owned_location = {
                limit = { oe_col_sparse = yes }
                order_by = oe_col_pick_score
                save_scope_as = oe_col_pick
            }
            if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_col_pick } oe_col_start = yes }
        }
    }
}

# Any scope. One debug-log line with phase 1's state (for the observer logger of the test mod).
oe_col_log = {
    debug_log = "OE_COL p1 sparse=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_col_sparse_n')|0] slots=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_col_slots_used')|0] s1=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.GetVariable('oe_col_s1_m').GetValue|0] s2=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.GetVariable('oe_col_s2_m').GetValue|0] settled=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.GetVariable('oe_col_n_settled').GetValue|0] pop=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.GetVariable('oe_col_pop_added').GetValue|1] nic=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.GetVariable('oe_col_fired_10').GetValue|0] quarrels=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_col_dsp_n')|0] events=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.GetVariable('oe_dbg_n_col').GetValue|0]"
}

# TEST PAGE ONLY. BYZ scope. Clears the line's variables on BYZ and its places (cooldowns, slots, queued quarrels); modifiers and people already added stay.
oe_col_test_reset = {
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_on } remove_variable = oe_col_on }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_act_cd } remove_variable = oe_col_act_cd }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_ev_cd } remove_variable = oe_col_ev_cd }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_target } remove_variable = oe_col_target }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_job } remove_variable = oe_col_job }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_group } remove_variable = oe_col_group }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_s1_loc } remove_variable = oe_col_s1_loc }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_s1_m } remove_variable = oe_col_s1_m }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_s1_kind } remove_variable = oe_col_s1_kind }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_s2_loc } remove_variable = oe_col_s2_loc }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_s2_m } remove_variable = oe_col_s2_m }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_s2_kind } remove_variable = oe_col_s2_kind }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_n_settled } remove_variable = oe_col_n_settled }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_pop_added } remove_variable = oe_col_pop_added }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_fired_10 } remove_variable = oe_col_fired_10 }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_dsp_on } remove_variable = oe_col_dsp_on }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_dsp_loc } remove_variable = oe_col_dsp_loc }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_dsp_kind } remove_variable = oe_col_dsp_kind }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_t_pop } remove_variable = oe_col_t_pop }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_t_total } remove_variable = oe_col_t_total }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_nic_city } remove_variable = oe_col_nic_city }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_nic_to } remove_variable = oe_col_nic_to }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_nic_choice } remove_variable = oe_col_nic_choice }
    every_owned_location = {
        limit = {
            OR = {
                has_variable = oe_col_cd
                has_variable = oe_col_dsp
                has_variable = oe_col_dsp_due
                has_variable = oe_col_kind
                has_variable = oe_col_young
            }
        }
        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_cd } remove_variable = oe_col_cd }
        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_dsp } remove_variable = oe_col_dsp }
        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_dsp_due } remove_variable = oe_col_dsp_due }
        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_kind } remove_variable = oe_col_kind }
        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_young } remove_variable = oe_col_young }
    }
}

# TEST PAGE ONLY. BYZ scope. oe_col.1 for the first sparse place, without the authority cost or the action's cooldown.
oe_col_test_fire_1 = {
    ordered_owned_location = {
        limit = { oe_col_sparse = yes }
        order_by = oe_col_pick_score
        save_scope_as = oe_col_pick
    }
    if = {
        limit = { exists = scope:oe_col_pick }
        set_variable = { name = oe_col_target value = scope:oe_col_pick }
        oe_col_fire_1 = yes
    }
}

# TEST PAGE ONLY. BYZ scope. Both migration slots end now (a quarrel may be queued).
oe_col_test_slots = {
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_s1_loc } set_variable = { name = oe_col_s1_m value = 1 } }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_s2_loc } set_variable = { name = oe_col_s2_m value = 1 } }
    oe_col_slot_tick = yes
}

# TEST PAGE ONLY. BYZ scope. oe_col.2 at once: a queued place (not waiting for its month), else any place of ours with this line's settlers.
oe_col_test_fire_2 = {
    random_owned_location = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_dsp } save_scope_as = oe_col_dsp_pick }
    if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_col_dsp_pick } oe_col_dsp_take = yes oe_col_fire_2 = yes }
    else_if = {
        limit = {
            any_owned_location = {
                OR = { has_location_modifier = oe_col_homesteads has_location_modifier = oe_col_foreign_settlers }
            }
        }
        random_owned_location = {
            limit = {
                OR = { has_location_modifier = oe_col_homesteads has_location_modifier = oe_col_foreign_settlers }
            }
            save_scope_as = oe_col_dsp_pick
        }
        set_variable = { name = oe_col_dsp_loc value = scope:oe_col_dsp_pick }
        set_variable = { name = oe_col_dsp_kind value = 2 }
        if = {
            limit = { scope:oe_col_dsp_pick = { NOT = { has_location_modifier = oe_col_foreign_settlers } } }
            set_variable = { name = oe_col_dsp_kind value = 1 }
        }
        oe_col_fire_2 = yes
    }
}

# TEST PAGE ONLY. BYZ scope. oe_col.10 at once (no window, no roll); with no refugees modifier anywhere, Constantinople gets the start event's modifier for a year first.
oe_col_test_fire_10 = {
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { any_owned_location = { has_location_modifier = oe_s37_nic_refugees } } }
        location:constantinople = {
            if = {
                limit = { owner ?= c:BYZ }
                add_location_modifier = { modifier = oe_s37_nic_refugees years = 1 mode = replace }
            }
        }
    }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_fired_10 } remove_variable = oe_col_fired_10 }
    oe_col_fire_10 = yes
}

# BYZ scope, monthly while the empire holds Constantinople. At most one optional event: the first of EVENT_ORDER whose turn comes (each takes the lock and starts the quiet months, so the rest wait).
oe_col_events = {
    oe_col_try_10 = yes
    oe_col_try_2 = yes
}

# BYZ scope, every January while the empire holds Constantinople (YEARLY).
oe_col_yearly = {
    oe_col_ai_year = yes
}

# BYZ scope, monthly: called by the main-line scheduler (gen_mainline_lock.py LINES, id 16 "col"); no hook of its own. Steps in order (MONTHLY): start the books, count the moves down, then (while the empire holds Constantinople) the January work and the optional events. Without Constantinople only the books run.
oe_col_monthly = {
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_col_on } } oe_col_init = yes }
    oe_col_slot_tick = yes
    if = {
        limit = { location:constantinople = { owner ?= c:BYZ } }
        if = { limit = { current_month = 1 } oe_col_yearly = yes }
        oe_col_events = yes
    }
}
